profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at Microsoft
profile.summary: Cloud, DevOps, Observability Software Engineer - I started my career in AT&T’s Network Cloud where I learned the ins and outs of OpenStack, Jenkins, Kubernetes, Python, then I took on the opportunity to further my cloud knowledge by joining Capital One where I dove quickly into AWS, automation, and data. After I moved to Microsoft to further my cloud engineering now in Azure. Here I have stretched myself into the engineer then manager role and current principal engineer role in the observability space. I strive to be the best engineer and teammate I can be through working hard, learning quickly, and pushing both myself and team in a positive way.  I enjoy the fast paced, evolving world, and truly love passing on the knowledge I gain through teaching and mentoring other software engineers!

Cloud Engineer focused on developing frameworks to ensure delivery of a stable cloud distribution through validation of deployment and functionality.
Daily use of Python, Jenkins, Docker, OpenStack, and more.

positions.description: Cloud developer on AT&T Network Cloud.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description: Worked on synthesizing and analyzing organic memory shape polymers created through thiol-ene reactions for future use in neural transmitters. Co-authored a research thesis.

volunteerExperiences.companyName: The Big Event at Texas A&M University
volunteerExperiences.description: The Big Event is one of the largest student-run service projects which gives back to the community. It is a great way to say "Thank You" to all of the residents in Bryan/College Station by doing requested work. I have gotten the opportunity to meet and help multiple individuals and families this way through yard work, cleaning garages, painting, and helping in whatever way needed!

company.name: The Big Event at Texas A&M University

volunteerExperiences.description: Community service and mission work in Pietermaritzburg, South Africa. For a overall total of over two weeks, I was given the amazing opportunity to lead, support, teach, help, and love on a community who all have literally nothing yet were undoubtedly deserving and amazing. I was able to teach kids and woman and also give them all I could. It changed me and taught me things a paragraph couldn't explain but most importantly how to give and love whole-heartingly.
